title: LvD Elemental grand laurel crown
creator: Softmax / Polyworld contributors
process: Recovered original procedural laurel geometry derived from the project Zeus crown materials and canonical Head rig. Replaced the tiara with two curved sprigs and sixteen faceted leaves; removed dormant tiara meshes and collapsed triangles at the leaf tips.
runtime: Elemental body takes the owning faction color; gold crown stays gold. Selectable in Chargen and merged into one game mesh.
review: Actual Polyworld CharacterScene renderer, Amethyst and Emerald; all eight faction tints tested.
